column1: # The import libraries of the Classic fragment, in the order of its library table and each one's symbols in loader order: interface facts as text, transcribed from the 1.0.10 loader. lib NAME OPTIONS (0x40 weak, 0x80 init before) STUB, sym NAME CLASS. STUB is the stub library peflink1010 --image links against: INSTALL:FILE a held CodeWarrior install's or Apple SDK's StubLibraries file, fork:NAME a container of the user's copy, gen one generated from the sym rows where no held stub gives this order (pin section 13).
